Ragas offline scoring adaptation

Project: https://github.com/explodinggradients/ragas
Revision: 298b68274234c060deacab3cf5fb52aa3a20e885
License: Apache License, Version 2.0 (see RAGAS-LICENSE)

backend/evaluation/scoring.py adapts AnswerCorrectness._compute_f1_score
from src/ragas/metrics/collections/answer_correctness/metric.py, lines 221-249.
The upstream license includes the copyright attribution to Vibrant Labs.

Modifications:
- Accept annotated counts directly instead of an LLM classification object.
- Validate counts and beta.
- Return None when there are no reference facts instead of assigning a perfect
  score to empty evidence.
- Use only the reference-fact F-beta calculation; do not include the upstream
  LLM statement extraction, classifier, embeddings similarity or weighting.

This small adaptation is not the complete Ragas AnswerCorrectness metric.
The surrounding schemas, review binding, input validation, source-ID coverage,
comparison reports and CLI are application-specific integration code.
No upstream endorsement is implied.
